Hi all — quick update from Billing Ops. We've correlated the sample lines Maya provided to request traces and found a session-id multiplication bug introduced during a small rollout on 2027-04-27 01:20 UTC. The bug caused a subset of requests to be replayed server-side, resulting in duplicated token accounting for the same logical client call.

Affected surface: NovaRetail production routes under model rwd-mosaic-v1, approx 4% of calls between 01:20–02:10 UTC.
Preliminary reconciliation: raw token count increase ~2.1x for the affected calls; estimated billable overcharge for Apr 27 = $7,410.

Actions taken so far:
- Incident logged: INC-20270427 (link below).
- Usage export attached (usage_export_20270428.csv) with per-request IDs and corrected token counts.
- We propose a one-time credit of $7,410 against the Apr invoice; we can also issue an additional goodwill credit of $1,500 to cover any downstream processing costs on your side. Total proposed credit = $8,910.

Please confirm that we should proceed with the credit and provide the contact for your AP team if you'd like a formal credit memo. We'll also publish a short postmortem and notify you when the fix is in prod and validated.

Neha Kapoor
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage_export_20270428.csv (stub)
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20270427

Hi Maya — appreciate the quick confirmation and your trust here. Finalizing next steps: 

1) Credits: Billing Ops will issue a credit memo for $7,410 (corrective) + $1,500 (goodwill) = $8,910. Expect the memo to be emailed to accounts-payable@novaretail.com by end of day Tue, 2027-05-04.

2) Deliverables we will attach to the memo: itemized CSV (per-request corrected counts), PDF credit_proposal_NovaRetail_20270503.pdf (signed by Finance), and the usage export we already shared.

4) Follow-up: I'll ping you on Wed 05/05 to confirm the memo arrived and that the credit applied to your account. If you'd like a short sync to walk through the CSV, Laura is available for a 20-minute call this week.

Thanks again for the patience — we're treating this as a priority.
